Date of Issue: 19-09-2026 Time of issue: 0530 hrs IST
FISHERMEN WARNING FOR GUJARAT COAST
(For 5 days from 18th September 2026 to 22nd September 2026)
Synoptic Situation: - Due to active monsoon conditions & steep pressure gradient Strong winds along &
off Gujarat coast very likely to prevail.
1. Fishermen warning for North Gujarat coast (Jakhau, Mandvi (Kutch), Mundra, New Kandla,
Navlakhi, Salaya, Okha, Bedi, Sikka(Jamnagar), Porbandar)
DAY 1- Strong wind speed 30-40 kmph gusting to 50 kmph is likely to prevail from South Westerly to
Westerly direction along and off North Gujarat coast. Sea will be rough with waves from South Westerly
to Westerly direction along and off North Gujarat coast.
DAY 2- NIL
DAY 3- NIL
DAY 4- NIL
DAY 5- NIL
*NOTE: Fishermen are advised to be cautious while venturing into the Sea.
2. Fishermen warning for South Gujarat coast (Muldwarka, Veraval, Diu, Jafrabad, Pipavav, Port
Victor, Bhavnagar, Alang, Bharuch, Dahej, Magdalla and Daman)
DAY 1- DAY 1- Strong wind speed 30-40 kmph gusting to 50 kmph is likely to prevail from South
Westerly to Westerly direction along and off North Gujarat coast. Sea will be rough with waves from
South Westerly to Westerly direction along and off North Gujarat coast.
DAY 2- NIL
DAY 3- NIL
DAY 4- NIL
DAY 5- NIL
*NOTE: Fishermen are advised to be cautious while venturing into the Sea.
3. Fishermen warning for other coasts:
DAY 1- NIL
DAY 2- NIL
DAY 3- NIL
DAY 4- NIL
DAY 5- NIL
*NOTE: No Fishermen warning from 18th September 2026 to 22nd September 2026.
4. Fishermen warning for open sea: –
DAY 1-Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail along and off north
Somalia coasts adjoining southwest & Westcentral Arabian Sea.
DAY 2-Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail along and of north
Somalia coasts adjoining southwest Arabian Sea.
DAY 3-Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail along and of north
Somalia coasts adjoining southwest Arabian Sea.
DAY 4-Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail along and of north
Somalia coasts adjoining southwest Arabian Sea.
DAY 5-Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail along and of north
Somalia coasts adjoining southwest Arabian Sea.
*NOTE: Fishermen are advised not to venture into above mentioned area during above mentioned period.
